messages:
Alex Kim: Quick check — Harbor pilot timeline update. Sales asked for go/no-go criteria and integration deliverables by next week. Engineering: can we confirm who owns the webhook retry/backoff work and the window for test signups?

Priya Nair: I can summarize success criteria: 1) model inference latency under 250ms p50 for standard prompts, 2) end-to-end webhook retries handled (3x, exponential), 3) SSO SAML handshake validated in staging, 4) 500 user signups in UAT. Need owners for webhook + SSO.

Marta Ruiz: From customer side: they need a clear cutover doc and an env that mirrors prod (VPC peering). Also want a runbook for fallback to hosted model if private node fails.

Tomas Alvarez: I can take webhook retry/backoff. Plan: implement idempotency token + exponential backoff up to 60s, then move to DLQ. Target branch PR by Wed EOD.

Alex Kim: Awesome. Can you add a short README with the retry semantics so SEs can test?

Tomas Alvarez: Yep, will add README + example curl. Example payload we'll use in tests: ```curl -X POST https://staging.harbor.example/webhook -H 'Idempotency-Key: <uuid>' -d '{"event":"inference.complete"}'```

Sean O'Connor: QA note: I'll run a 2-hour flood test once Tomas lands the PR. Please tag QA in the PR. Also need a way to drain the DLQ for retries — is that existing infra?

Sarah Li: DLQ drain tool exists in eng-infra, but we'll need a short playbook for SEs. I can add a one-pager. Who owns the SSO handshake test?

Priya Nair: I'll own SSO validation with the customer. Need a small config change from Tomas' side to accept SAML audience: `aud=https://harbor-customer/staging`. Tomas — can you expose that env var in the staging helm values?

Tomas Alvarez: Yes, I'll add `SAML_AUD` to staging values and create a values schema entry.

Marta Ruiz: Also pinging infra for VPC peering window — customer requests a maintenance slot next Thurs 02:00-06:00 UTC. @Sarah Li is that doable?

Sarah Li: Tentative OK, will coordinate with eng-infra. If peering needs a CIDR change we need ticket with networking details by EOD Tuesday.

Alex Kim: Owners recap so we don't lose this in threads: Tomas = webhook retry + helm var, Priya = SSO validation + acceptance tests, Sean = QA flood + DLQ validation, Sarah = DLQ playbook + infra coordination, Marta = customer coordination + runbook. I'll track milestones in the POC doc and flag anything blocking.

Priya Nair: Small ask for SE test harness: can eng expose a short endpoint returning KV cache stats? Customer wants to confirm caching is effective. Endpoint could be `/internal/cache-stats`. Tomas?

Tomas Alvarez: I can add a read-only endpoint gated by X-Internal-Token header. Will include response example and rate limit it.

Sean O'Connor: QA will need a sample token and expected schema. Please add to the README.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: staging/webhook-service @tomas-alvarez -> sha:fa12b3c; status: in_progress :rocket:

Marta Ruiz: Thanks team. If Tomas' deploy is green, can we schedule the first UAT window Fri 09:00-11:00 UTC? Customer prefers morning.

Alex Kim: Tentative yes, contingent on flood test results and SSO handshake passing. I'll put a tentative calendar invite and mark as tentative until Sean confirms.

Sean O'Connor: Will confirm by Thu EOD after QA run.

Priya Nair: I'll start drafting the acceptance checklist and drop it in the POC doc.

Alex Kim: Perfect. If anything blocks (networking tickets, infra churn), please @me directly so I can escalate with Customer Success. :thumbsup:
